name: Policy
description: Policy schema from AWS IAM API

PolicyName.description: The friendly name identifying the policy.

PolicyId.description: The stable and unique string identifying the policy.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the policy.

DefaultVersionId.description: The identifier for the version of the policy that is the default.

AttachmentCount.description: The number of entities the policy is attached to.

IsAttachable.description: Specifies whether the policy can be attached.

CreateDate.description: The date and time when the policy was created.

UpdateDate.description: The date and time when the policy was last updated.
